SELECT
  100 * on_time_loads / nullif(on_time_measured_loads, 0) AS on_time_rate
FROM (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'deliveries'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'delivered_date'
  -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
